extracted.name: Pumpkin Casserole
extracted.description: This pumpkin casserole is super easy, something different, and tastes great with the main course. Enjoy!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine pumpkin, evaporated milk, sugar, flour, eggs, vanilla, melted butter, and ground cinnamon to taste. Spoon into a casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour.
